headline: Doctoral thesis reports SystemC-AMS virtual testing for gate-driver test hardware
fact: Davide Turossi reported defending his doctoral thesis at the University of Milano-Bicocca on June 4, 2026 and explicitly thanked Infineon for hosting and supporting the research. The university abstract describes a SystemC-AMS/COSIDE framework modeling automatic test equipment, devices under test and probe-card circuitry. Its gate-driver cases address over-current protection and output peak-current measurement, comparing virtual test solutions with measurements on manufactured hardware. This records the thesis and acknowledged research support, not company-wide adoption.
